data.body: Decision (settled from precedent, 2026-11-03 PST): local index git operations on the event write path move to gitutil._LOCAL_GIT_TIMEOUT (120 s); network git keeps the 30 s push bound. Evidence: c2ba (melting-resting-serpent) description asks only that the lock-held git calls 'carry a timeout, matching push.py' (AC3) and its approach says 'give the lock-held git calls the same _GIT_TIMEOUT treatment push.py already uses'; its only comment is the FORCE_CLOSE record. Nothing in the record sizes 30 s for index work. The same trade-off was ruled for sync in painted-epidermal-shelduck (Gerrit 3248, 225f227c3fb). Accepted cost: a stalled volume holds the store write lock up to 120 s per git call before the write fails, the same as run_git_write and sync already do. Grace-period dependency: review_bot.config.shutdown_force_exit_grace_seconds = lock budget 60 + event_commit_git._GIT_TIMEOUT, so the force-exit deadline moves from 1300 s to 1390 s, past the review-bot's 1320 s stop_grace_period; it is re-derived to 1440 s. MCP 1260 s derives only from the 1200 s certified-op grace and is unaffected.
